title: Cancelling the confirmation changes nothing
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user (Admin) · 1 browser · about 10 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: [Admin] = you, signed in with the Admin role, which by default has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Location: [Loc-1] = the location picked in the top-bar location switcher at the start; every step runs at [Loc-1] unless it names another location.
  • Data: [Part-A], [Part-B] = tracked parts, active, numbers sharing the start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CANCEL-0.
  • Names and numbers marked (e.g. …) are examples only. What must hold is the status (active or inactive), tracking, quantity and link described above.

Setup

  1. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL CANCEL A), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CANCEL-01), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00); leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  2. [Part-A] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CANCEL-01); [Desc-A] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL CANCEL A).
  3. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL CANCEL B), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CANCEL-02), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00); leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  4. [Part-B] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CANCEL-02); [Desc-B] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL CANCEL B).
  5. Check the setup worked: both parts are on the Active tab and neither has a Deactivated entry in Part History.
custom_steps:
1. On the Active tab search "ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CANCEL-0", turn on "Deactivate parts", tick both parts and click "Deactivate".
  2. Click "Cancel" in the confirmation, then × on the bulk bar.
  3. Open [Part-A], pick "Inactive", click Save, then click "Cancel" in the confirmation.
  4. Click Cancel in the part dialog.
  5. Open [Part-A]'s and [Part-B]'s Part History.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: Both parts are still on the Active tab.
  • Step 3: The confirmation closes and the part dialog is back with "Inactive" still picked and the pill still "Active".
  • Step 4: [Part-A] is still on the Active tab.
  • Step 5: Neither part has a "Deactivated" entry.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v26 (Ready for dev), S10-N1, read 8 Oct 2026; design canvas boards 3.3 and 4.4. Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S10-N1: “If the user cancels the confirmation, no part changes status.”
